size_note: 102 x 43 x 13 mm (GSMArena spec sheet, teltarif, devicebeast); the GSMArena review text says 112 mm, but the frontal press render measures 0.425 width/height, which fits 102 mm

screen.note: w/h from 1.8in at 240:320, x centred; y = top edge of the active area of the see-through display, measured on the frontal press render (esato)

seams.note: lower edge of the clear glass display panel, top of the black keypad body

key_icons: The keys are four full-width glossy black bars with white labels, the small letters printed under each digit, not beside it. The 1 key shows a small voicemail icon under the 1; the * key shows '+' and a small key-lock symbol under the *; the 0 key shows a small space symbol under the 0; the # key shows 'a/A' and a small silent (crossed note) symbol under the #.
keypad_labels: 2 ABC, 3 DEF, 4 GHI, 5 JKL, 6 MNO, 7 PQRS, 8 TUV, 9 WXYZ, letters under the digits

screen.note: screen hole in skin.png (12 px/mm, 1 mm padding); exact native aspect
